note: Written synonym table mapping SceneDiff ground-truth object labels to the closed vocabulary in data/naming_vocabulary.json. A null mapping means the object is not in the vocabulary; those crops are counted separately and never silently dropped. Suffixes like _1 and _2 are dataset instance ids, not part of the name.

unmapped.Air Hockey Sticker_1: a sticker is a surface decoration, not in the vocabulary
unmapped.magazine_1: the vocabulary has book, not magazine
unmapped.pajamas_1: garment type not in the vocabulary
unmapped.gray_pajamas: garment type not in the vocabulary
unmapped.gray_pajamas_1: garment type not in the vocabulary
unmapped.plaid_pajamas_top: garment part, and the vocabulary forbids part names
unmapped.plaid_pajamas_top_1: garment part, and the vocabulary forbids part names
unmapped.plaid_pajamas_bottom: garment part, and the vocabulary forbids part names
unmapped.plaid_pajamas_bottom_1: garment part, and the vocabulary forbids part names
unmapped.car_1: could be a toy car or a real one; the vocabulary only has toy car, so it is left unmapped rather than guessed
unmapped.Yoga Mat_1: mat is not in the vocabulary
unmapped.Cleaner_1: unclear whether this is a spray bottle, a cloth or a machine
unmapped.placemat_1: placemat is not in the vocabulary
